programs.name: validated_damped_trend
programs.description: Use when rolling scores are stable across origins but the recent history has persistent local movement that a seasonal-lag or level fallback may follow too slowly; causal multi-step hindcasts gate a bounded damped-trend forecast, otherwise the method retains the robust level forecast.
programs.assumption: Over at least 24 causal validation errors, a locally estimated damped trend must reduce median absolute error by at least 3% versus a trailing-12 median before receiving any weight, and its weight is capped at 0.65.
programs.failure_condition: It fails when a new level shift or reversal occurs after the forecast origin, or when the selected trend does not preserve its causal validation advantage over the next 24 observed points.
